en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, raising it, said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The moderation (leads to) prosperity, and the extravagance (leads to) ruination’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated in a marfu‘ manner who has said the following: “’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Moderation leads to increase, and extravagance leads to destruction.’”
